Though successful, it took several minutes after they were back on the floor for her complexion to lose the viridian hue it had taken.
b_d62: Rin: Why would he put in a loop-de-loop?
b_d63_note: Sonic replied, grinning from the adrenaline.
b_p53: As they continued on, the ship suddenly shook as if something heavy from the outside struck it. Sonic’s communicator beeped, and although it wasn’t his style, the Hedgehog stopped to put Rin down to respond. Tails’ voice began to speak from it.
b_d64: Tails: Sonic! Have you found Rin yet?!
b_p54: The fox sounded a little frantic.
b_d65_note: Sonic said, holding his wrist up to Rin.
b_d68: Rin: We heard something hit the ship.
b_d69: Tails: We’ve got bogies! And not the ones Eggman made!
b_d70: Sonic: What, you mean the air force caught up with us?
b_d70_note: Sonic asked, taking his wrist back.
b_d71: Tails: Yes! There are jets trying to shoot the Flying Torpedo down!
b_d72: Sonic: Have they gone after you?
b_d73: Tails: No, the jets are focused on the airship. They’ve avoided Eggman’s return-fire so far, but Saber and I can’t protect them without doing something that could expose Magecraft.
b_p55: Sonic nodded, his expression becoming more serious.
b_d74: Sonic: Got it. See if you can tell them to break off their attack. I doubt they’ve got anything that could do any damage.
b_p57: Rin sniffed, her way of assuring that no offense had been taken.
b_d76: Tails: Roger. I’ll get under the airship to catch you. Just give me a heads-up when you get ready to bail. Over and out!
b_p58: The jets soared around the Flying Torpedo, trying to take potshots while dodging missiles and missile-like robots. There were only four planes, but reinforcements were already on the way. The air was full of tension, adrenaline, and this radio chatter:
b_d77: Falcon-1: This is Falcon-1 to base. We have located the UFO and are engaging. Sending our coordinates, over!
b_d78: Falcon-2: Falcon-2 here. Falcon-1, what about the red bi-plane following? Over.
b_d79: Falcon-1: We have orders not to concern ourselves with the bi-plane, Falcon-2, over.
b_d80: Falcon-2: It’s just…it looks like it’s being flown by a kitsune, and there’s this girl standing on the wings…
b_d81: Falcon-1: Let it be, Falcon-2. Over.
b_d82: Falcon-3: This is Falcon-3, the UFO is releasing bogies, over!
b_p59: Falcon-2: Falcon-3, this is Falcon-2, what do you- Are those
b_d83: Falcon-4: Falcon-4 here! The target has missile-launchers on both starboard and port!
b_d84: Tails: Helloooo? Is this the right frequency?
b_p61: Captain Reiji looked suddenly at his radio. That sounded like a child!
b_d85: Reiji (Falcon-1): Who the hell is this!?
b_p62: Reiji’s eyes slowly turned outside his cockpit. They were directed towards the red biplane.
b_d86: Reiji (Falcon-1): Are you…is this the bi-plane?!
b_d87_note: Reiji could almost imagine an eager face nodding.
b_d88: Tails: You can call me Tails. Listen, you have to withdraw! Eggman’s only getting started! And even if you could fight him, you might end up hurting…uh, someone.
b_d90: Falcon-3: We’re trying to hurt him!
b_d91: Tails: No, that’s not my point!
b_d92: Tails: Eggman’s kidnapped a girl! I don’t know who she is, but Sonic’s on board the Flying Torpedo rescuing her!
b_d94: Falcon-2: Hey…isn’t Sonic that tanuki that helped the Bug Queen save the school a few days ago?
b_d95: Tails: He’s a hedgehog. And yes!
b_p63: Reiji gritted his teeth. This was absolutely inane. It felt like real-life had been supplanted by one of his kids’ anime. That said, his older daughter had sent an email about being saved by a kitsune. As much as his training told him otherwise, Reiji had a gut feeling that ‘Tails’ was being legitimate. However, they couldn’t let a chance to take down a dangerous terrorist slip away. All attempts to locate Eggman’s base so far had failed. The airship was the best lead they had. And so, he made a compromise.
b_d97: Reiji (Falcon-1): Tails-san, we’re giving your friend Sonic five minutes to rescue the hostage.
b_d98: Reiji (Falcon-1): That’s the ETA we have for reinforcements. During that time, Falcon-2 through 4, I want you to focus on taking down those bogies and the turrets. Do you copy?
b_d99_note: Three voices Reiji recognized replied. There was also a fourth voice that Reiji had never heard before this day.
b_d100: Tails: Thank you, sir. And don’t worry, five minutes is plenty of time for Sonic.
b_d101: Tails: He should be out of there in half of that!
b_d102: Reiji (Falcon-1): He sounds pretty confident…wish I had something to feel confident about!
b_p64: By that time, Sonic had taken Rin to a large hangar bay. At least, Rin assumed it was a hangar bay. However, there were no vehicles of any kind in sight. It was just a large, empty chamber with enough space to fit several jets.
b_d104: Rin: Why isn’t there anything here?
b_d106: Sonic: This is where Eggman’s gonna sic a giant robot on us.
b_d108: Sonic: Or, he’s gonna take us on himself.
b_d109: Sonic: Trust me, I’ve done this song and dance before. Empty room always means a big fight’s coming.
b_d110: Rin: You’re very laid-back for someone who’s expecting a battle.
b_p65: Even the calm of Saber or Archer was laced with an edge. Sonic looked like he was about to take a walk on the beach.
b_d111: Sonic: First rule of adventures: always keep a level head.
b_p66: Rin looked around the area. The stillness was getting to her.
b_d113: Rin: So, what should we expect?
b_d114: Sonic: That’s the second rule: don’t expect anything. Just learn to roll with it.
c_audio1: Sonic Adventure OST - Theme of Dr. Eggman
c_p1: Before Rin could further question Sonic, a horrible laughter filled the room. It was Eggman. Lights that were once dimmed turned to full brightness, and Rin could see Dr. Eggman, piloting that accursed Egg Cracker that had humiliated her back in Fuyuki. Behind him, however, was a new threat. A giant robot, easily twice the Egg Cracker’s size, was there. Looking at it, Rin was vaguely reminded of a pig’s head. On its left and right were gigantic wheels, like the kind used by monster trucks seen on insipid TV shows. (Rin only made the comparison later, after relating her experience to Archer. She had never seen a monster truck rally before.) The two holes in the “snout” glowed ominously. On its back, a pair of giant exhaust pipes puffed smog as an engine within revved up.
c_d2: Sonic: Gee, Eggman. With those jets buzzing this ship, I didn’t think you’d have time to see us off! What a sweet guy.
c_d3: Eggman: Hah! If the standard military of our world couldn’t stop me, there’s no way the sub-standard military of this world could!
c_p4: As a Mage, Rin had no problem with Eggman’s demeaning the level of her country’s technological development. But as a citizen of Japan, she felt that she had a duty to defend her nation’s honor. To compromise between these two mentalities, Rin’s frown deepened and she clenched her fist. Stepping closer to Sonic, she whispered:
c_d4: Rin: Be careful, Sonic. Eggman’s weird machine has some kind of punching device if you get too close, hidden in a compartment at the front.
c_d6: Sonic: I’d love to stay here and shoot the breeze with ya, Eggers, but I’ve gotta get the little lady home. Her parents don’t like it when she’s out too late, you understand.
c_d7: Eggman: Goodness, I had no idea I was being so thoughtless!
c_d7_note: Eggman gasped with mock-worry. Sneering, he pointed at the two.
c_audio2: Sonic Adventure OST - Egg Mobile (Egg Hornet)
c_p7: The pig-robot’s giant tires screeched against the floor as Skweel charged at Sonic and Rin. Sonic rushed towards Skweel, but easily hopped over him to go at Eggman. Rin, Reinforcing her body, leapt to the side to avoid being run down.
c_p8: Meanwhile, Eggman attempted to crush Sonic with the Egg Cracker’s drill-bits, but the Hedgehog dodged the attack and hit the vehicle with a Homing Shot. Yelling in alarm, Eggman shot both a glare and several spike balls at Sonic — and missed. Sonic effortlessly ducked and weaved around the shots, and the spike balls either landed harmlessly on the floor or embedded themselves in the wall.
c_d9: Sonic: Hey! Would it help if I put a bullseye on my tummy?
c_d9_note: Sonic taunted, giving one spike ball a sidelong glance.
c_d10: Rin: Don’t get near those things, Sonic!
c_d10_note: Rin yelled as she dodged another charge from Skweel.
c_d12_note: Sonic’s eyes widened slightly and he put some distance between himself and the spike balls.
c_p9: As Sonic hopped back, he heard a screech of tires and realized that Skweel was making an attempt to run him over. He jumped into the air as Skweel roared under him, then landed a Homing Shot on the robot’s back. Rather than acting hurt, Skweel whirled about in a desperate attempt to counterattack, but Sonic nimbly bounced away.
c_p10: Rin, meanwhile, kept her distance from both robot and mad scientist. This was something she and Sonic had discussed during their brief journey through the airship. If and when the two of them would run into either Eggman or one of his sub-bosses (and Sonic was pretty insistent that it would happen), the key to victory was patience.
c_p11: Despite his eagerness to rush into danger, Sonic made it clear that blindly charging at an enemy would be suicidal; the best tactic was to wait for an opening, then charge in. As Rin ducked, weaved, and leapt away from Eggman’s weapons and Skweel’s rushes, she realized that this strategy worked best for Sonic, whose reaction time was superior to even Lancer’s. He could be on the other side of the room and make it in time to capitalize on a moment of weakness.
c_p12: Rin, on the other hand, was still human, even with Reinforcement enhancing her abilities. And the one time she was able to land a hit on Skweel, there seemed to be no effect. It was so frustrating! How could she tell if it was damaged if it didn’t have any mana? Sonic had assured her that if they just kept at it, the damage would take effect soon enough, but Rin wasn’t too confident with that.
c_d14: Rin: There has to be something more I can do!
c_d15: Rin: Running around and randomly hitting things are for…neanderthals!
c_p13: Luckily, and perhaps insultingly, neither Eggman nor Skweel were particularly keen on keeping track of Rin. If she wanted to be generous, Rin would believe that it was due to Eggman’s longstanding grudge against Sonic that compelled him to target the Hedgehog. It was better than the assumption that, having already defeated her previously, Eggman decided Rin was not worth his effort.
c_p14: At one point, Sonic seemed to be cornered by both Eggman and Skweel. As the two enemies closed in, Sonic ran up the wall, and once he was high enough, shot over Eggman’s head. Once he was down on the other side, he took the chance to Homing Shot the Egg Cracker again.
c_d16_note: Eggman exclaimed as his cockpit was jostled. He turned the craft around and began to fire spike balls.
c_d17: Eggman: I hate you, I hate you, I hate you!
c_d18_note: Rin thought, dodging the projectiles. Inspiration then struck.
c_p15: With a look of determination that would have impressed Shirou, Rin began to run towards the nearest bomb. As she did, she began to focus all of her Mage Circuits in her leg.
c_p16: The bombs were on timers, but they also could be detonated remotely. Luckily, Eggman was more focused on Sonic than her. Furthermore, they were clearly designed not to explode on impact, as none detonated after slamming into walls.
c_p17: With that in mind, Rin swept her leg out at the spike ball, and in a move that would have made high school soccer captains the world over green with envy, kicked it! The spike ball soared across the room and slammed into Skweel’s left wheel. This had numerous effects; one, the impact of the bomb disrupted the robot’s path, nearly knocking it off on its side. That’s when the bomb went off. While the spike ball was designed to resist the force of most impacts, Rin’s kick had jammed the circuitry, causing it to explode preemptively. The force of the blast was enough to completely knock Skweel on its side, and the porcine robot spun around aimlessly, making whining noises that sounded very similar to a certain breed of farm livestock.
c_d20: Sonic: Nice one, Rin! You play soccer, or are you just on reserve?
c_d21: Eggman: That does it! Now I’m setting these to go off on impact!
c_p20: The Egg Cracker’s cannon fired another slew of spike balls, this time aimed at Rin. Before they reached her, Sonic made a move of his own. Getting between Mage and bomb, he ran around in a tight circle, creating a miniature whirlwind. This caught the spike balls and sent them high into the air. The bombs collided with each other and created a massive explosion that almost knocked Rin off of her feet. But just as she was regaining her balance, Sonic scooped her up and made a mad dash away from the blast.
c_d22: Sonic: I’d say we’ve worn out our welcome…
c_d23: Sonic: Besides, I think I found a way out of here!
c_p21: Sonic stopped, and Rin saw that they were standing in front of a large, egg-shaped hatch labeled:
c_p22: ‘Emergency Exit: Use Only In Case Of Emergencies’.
c_p23: There was also a smaller label, reading:
c_d24: WARNING: Do Not Use Unless Flying Torpedo is on Water Surface!
c_p24: Horror flowed into Rin’s features as she realized where the hatch led — and what Sonic was about to do.
c_p25: Sonic had already forced the hatch open.
c_p26: Rin’s terrified shrieks bounced up and out of the chute as she and Sonic fell down it. Eggman punched his console in frustration. As the pair continued their high-speed descent, Sonic activated his communicator.
c_d27: Sonic: Tails, get ready to catch us! We’re about to- Rin, stop screaming, I can’t hear myself- come out of the airship!
c_d28: Sonic: Track us with the GPS!
c_d29: Tails: Okay, Sonic, leave it to me!
c_d29_note: Tails replied, and the ME’s screen turned black, with a red arrow spinning around.
c_d30: Tails: Do you see them, Saber?
c_p28: Saber pointed. In the distance, she could see a dot falling from the airship. She could also hear a faint screaming.
c_p30: Saber bent down and held on to the wing as the Tornado curved and shot towards the falling pair. Once they were close enough, the biplane went into a nosedive. While Tails had done this sort of thing dozens of times with Sonic, he was worried that Rin’s inexperience with these high velocities might hurt her. Therefore, he had to make the catch at a curve in order to invert her inertia and hopefully keep her guts from spilling out.
c_p31: Reaching out with one hand, Saber took hold of Rin and pulled her from Sonic’s arms and into her own grip. The Hedgehog took this moment to grab hold of the Tornado’s wings. Once everyone was aboard, Tails began to level out the plane. Once this action was complete, Saber deposited Rin into the back seat.
c_p32: Instead of answering, Rin forced her head over the side. A hideous retching noise was lost in the wind.
c_d35: Tails: Great…I just got this thing waxed…
c_p34: Standing up, Sonic brushed himself off.
c_d36: Sonic: Well, I’d call that a Rank-A success. Wanna stop by a Denny’s on our way back?
c_p35: Sonic saw that there was a steel in her eyes and voice stronger than the one in her hands.
c_d38: Saber: It is time we put an end to this.
c_audio3: Fate/stay night [Réalta Nua] (PS Vita) OST - Sword of Promised Victory (2012)
c_p36: There was a brilliant flash of light. Saber had removed Invisible Air from her sword. Without the spell to bend the air currents, there was nothing to hide the true form of Saber’s blade.
c_p37: And it was a sword Sonic had seen before.
c_p38: It was in a different place. A different story. But Sonic could recognize that weapon anywhere.
c_p39: Light began to gather around the metal. Saber lifted the sword over her head. She stared resolutely at the departing airship.
c_p40: Eggman furrowed his brow as he stared at his console’s screen. Smack dab in the center of the footage was Saber and her glowing sword.
c_d39_note: He asked aloud. A red light began to flash, and a series of numbers flashed by.
c_p41: There were different types of Noble Phantasms.
c_p42: ‘s Gae Bolg could pierce through time in order to reach his victim’s heart without fail. And while he could do it multiple times at once, it was still a weapon that could only strike a single opponent. Saber’s, however, was of an entirely different nature. It wasn’t one she could freely use in Fuyuki. Not because of the minimal Prana she received from Shirou (although that was certainly an unavoidable factor). Her Noble Phantasm was one that affected everyone and everything within its radius. It was an ability-type called anti-fortress. Unleashing it within the city was unthinkable. Even if she could bury her own honor down deep enough to forego the safety of the citizens, her Master would never agree to such a pyrrhic victory. But out over the ocean, with the sky as a backdrop…
c_p44: There was a brilliant flash of light, so great that it briefly eclipsed the sun. And when it faded, there was no sign of the Flying Torpedo. The Tornado did a U-turn and flew back to Fuyuki.
c_p45: The Japanese Air Defense jets also returned to base. Captain Reiji’s formal report on the mission had to undergo numerous re-writes, before it was decided that his cockpit had been low on oxygen, and he had hallucinated the ‘giant sword beam of certain death’ while Eggman’s ship self-destructed due to some unforeseen accident.
c_p47: got home, he was stressed from arranging all of those memory alterations. But, he was pleased with his work.
c_p48: Zouken Matou was also pleased. Thanks to Sakura, that stupid tanuki had given him all of the information he needed to make some sense of the current situation.
c_p49: He didn’t care about Dr. Eggman. Not at all. Even the idea, laughable as it was, that Eggman could track Magecraft with his technology.
c_p50: But the Emeralds…these Chaos Emeralds could be what he needed to achieve his wish, after all of these years.
c_d43: Zouken: No Servants, no Command Seals…
c_d43_note: The wizened mummy of a Mage thought greedily.
c_d44: Zouken: Just power to whomever can gather them.
c_p51: And gather them he will. Or wait for someone else to gather them…
c_p52: was pleased. While her first foray in the Special Zone had not yielded a Chaos Emerald, the Power Rings she gathered during her time there were a worthwhile consolation prize. Even without her sixth sense, she could feel the energy they radiated. With them, she could bolster her Magecraft without taking Mana from the citizens of Fuyuki. From what she had gleaned from her scrying, Special Zones reappeared after a certain amount of time. She would make another attempt to take the Chaos Emerald at a later date. For now, she would experiment, and prepare her spells. Maybe she would be able to send Assassin off as something more than a gatekeeper.
c_d45_note: Caster thought, holding one ring to her eye.
c_d46: Caster: I’ll be prepared for those stupid spike balls…
c_p53: As Caster teleported into the Ryuudou Shrine, she didn’t notice a blinking light from one of the statues…

d_p1: When the Tornado landed at the Tohsaka Mansion, Shirou and Archer were already there to greet the crew. They had been there since the battle at the harbor, waiting for everyone to come home.
d_p2: Seeing both Saber on the wing and Rin in the back seat brought a relieved smile to Shirou’s face. And while Archer’s face was as stoic as ever, his heart shared Shirou’s sentiments. Having mostly gotten over her nausea, Rin flashed the two boys a shaky thumbs-up. Tails laughed, and Sonic grinned.
d_d1_note: Shirou cried, rushing over. Reinforcing his legs without even realizing, he managed to catch his Servant before she hit the ground.
d_d4: Saber: I am merely…tired…from using my Noble Phantasm.
d_d5_note: Shirou asked, and behind him, Archer’s eyes widened.
d_d7: Archer: What kind of battle did she experience to resort to that?
d_p4: That’s why she’s like this…using a Noble Phantasm requires an enormous amount of Prana, Shirou realized. More than a second-rate Mage like me can supply. Wait, that’s it! He dug into his pockets, and brought out a handful of Power Rings.
d_d8: Shirou: Saber, take these! Use them to restore yourself! That’s an order!
d_p5: Saber glanced up at Shirou’s determined eyes, and then reached out for his hand. The Rings glowed even brighter, and one by one, they floated off of Shirou’s palm and into her body. Once the glow subsided, the knight’s pallor returned, and she stood up, though still clearly tired.
d_d10: Sonic: You shoulda seen it, man.
d_d10_note: Sonic said, hopping off of the biplane’s wing.
d_d11: Sonic: Saber blew up Eggman’s airship single-handedly!
d_d12_note: Shirou asked, looking at the Hedgehog.
d_d13_note: Tails said, flying out of the cockpit with the Miles Electric.
d_d14: Tails: I managed to get it on camera. Check out this action!
d_p6: Shirou gaped at the recorded footage of Saber swinging down her sword, which was followed by a blinding light.
d_d15: Sonic: Yeah, Eggman wishes he could build a death ray like that!
d_d16: Sonic: Oh, I wish I could’ve seen the look on his face.
d_p7: At hearing Eggman’s name, Rin allowed herself a smile of her own.
d_d17: Rin: That’s one less thing for us to worry about. It didn’t exactly go as I wanted, but the plan worked, at least. Mission accomplished.
d_d19_note: Rin answered. A bit more thoughtfully, she added:
d_d20: Rin: Look, I imagine you guys have some code of honor against killing, but this is serious. The longer Eggman kept attacking the city, the more likely the Mage’s Association will take drastic action. We had to finish Eggman off.
d_d22: Tails: What makes you think Eggman’s dead?
d_d23: Archer: You think he could have survived Saber’s Noble Phantasm?
d_d24: Sonic: Hey, this wouldn’t be the first time someone shot a death ray through his ship with him on it.
d_d26: Rin: How could anyone survive what Saber did?!
d_d27: Tails: Look, the last time we foiled Eggman’s schemes, it resulted in a black hole sucking up his space station.
d_d28: Tails: If you can explain that one, I’d love to hear it.
d_d29: Rin: I…I wouldn’t even know where to begin…
d_p8: Once more she felt a huge gap between her own skills and experiences and that of Tails’. It took the wind out of her metaphorical ‘victory balloon.’
d_d30: Shirou: So everything that happened today was completely pointless…
d_d31: Sonic: Jeez, you guys are depressing. No wonder ya’ll suck at this hero thing.
d_d31_note: Sonic sighed, on his way to a tree to sit under.
d_p9: He rested his head against the trunk.
d_d32: Sonic: Look, we took out one of Eggman’s battleships, and every weapon on it. That’s less weapons Eggy’s gonna throw at us next time.
d_d34: Saber: The War may not be over, but for now…we have achieved a victory. That is something to take pride in.
d_p10: Shirou exhaled. Saber had a point. Eggman had used up a lot of robots at the harbor. And with the destruction of his airship — which could go underwater — it would be a while before he could launch another attack. That gave them some time before he could try again.
d_p11: Dr. Eggman staggered into the factory section of the Egg Saucer. The ends of his mustache were so frayed that it looked like someone had attacked him with a jagged, bent comb. When his instruments detected the energy output from Saber’s sword, Eggman immediately evacuated the Flying Torpedo. The power stones he had taken from Rin allowed him to bolster the Egg Mobile’s shields enough to survive the blast, and then limp back into his base. The minute he touched down in the launch bay, his hovercraft had fallen to pieces.

d_d37_note: Orbot guessed, wisely hovering out of leg’s length.
d_d38: Eggman: It was a total disaster!
d_d38_note: Eggman shouted, waving his arms in frustration.
d_d39: Eggman: I almost got killed, and I lost the Flying Torpedo in one fell swoop!
d_d40: Cubot: Maybe you shouldn’t leave the self-destruct where Sonic’ll find it.

d_d41: Eggman: It wasn’t Sonic this time…not completely, anyway. How can I conquer a world if it’s full of super-powered kids?
d_d42: Cubot: Aww, don’t be like that, doc.
d_d42_note: Cubot said, removing shards with Orbot’s help.

d_d44: Eggman: What the- how’d he get in there?
d_d44_note: The doctor demanded, stomping over to Shinji.

d_d47_note: Orbot murmured, putting the shards he had taken off Cubot back in the bin.
d_d48: Orbot: I wonder how he got in there.
d_d49: Eggman: Well, never mind how he got here, get rid of him!
d_d50: Eggman: I don’t have time for this!
d_d51_note: Shinji gasped, struggling to stand up.
d_d52: Shinji: Wha…what are you going to do?
d_d53_note: Orbot asked, turning to his master.

d_d56: Cubot: What if he’s one of those kids with superpowers?

d_d58: Orbot: He’s completely clean of Chaos energy.

d_d61_note: Shinji cried out, holding out his hands.
d_d62: Shinji: Don’t do this! You don’t want to do this!

d_p27: And with the same amount of collateral damage.
d_d64: Shinji: Because I can tell you about those super powered kids!
d_p28: The robots stopped. Eggman smoothed out his mustache. Shinji felt a grin forming on his face as an idea formed in his head.

Though functional, Shirou seems to suffer from a form of survivor’s guilt where he does not turn down any request asked of him. Furthermore, scanners salvaged from robots indicate that his body contains a small amount of X energy, the amount of which fluctuates depending on his proximity with...

d_d91: Special skills: swordsmanship, eating three times her body weight, motorcycle riding.
d_d92: Description: Kiritsugu’s former subordinate from 10 years ago, Saber vanished from the public eye following the Great Fire. Strangely enough, she seems to have not aged during that time! The large amounts of X energy inside her may be a factor in her apparent agelessness. Wherever she was, she has reappeared to act as Shirou’s bodyguard during this period of mysterious deaths and mass fainting. She has a very stoic behavior, but so far has not shown any hostile activity.
